title: Defer Computer Use permission setup until the first desktop tool
hypothesis: Interactive startup should not ask for Screen Recording when no desktop tool was used, especially with a fresh isolated HOME that installs a new ad-hoc helper identity.
measurement: Local diagnosis: the canonical signed helper returned accessibility=true, screenRecordingPreflight=true and screenRecordingCapturable=true; tccd attributed a 23:07:49 prompt to an isolated ad-hoc helper under /private/tmp/rotom-s6b-home. A focused regression failed before the change and passed after it. Isolated installed-package startup and archive checks were run separately.
result: The extension no longer initializes desktop permissions on session_start. Its tool executor still checks permissions before a desktop tool runs. Already-running old isolated sessions can still prompt until they exit.
